/            Filter Mode
?            Help
Ctrl-D       Delete
Ctrl-R       Refresh
Ctrl-S       Save
Ctrl-W       Toggle Wide
Ctrl-Z       Toggle Faults
Ctrl-\       Marks Clear
Enter        View
Esc          Filter Reset
Shift-N      Sort Name
Shift-O      Sort Selected Column
Shift-S      Sort Status
c            Copy
key-272      Help
q            Filter Reset
r            Rename
